name: [Update 7.5] Clicker Incremental
desc:
Have in mind game starts really slowly, in future updates it will be way easier, so consider just playing game later or just get to the point where its easy before disliking game.

Currently 5 rooms with different features, upgrades, etc.

!! Game saves by itself !!

Clicker Incremental is all about unlocking upgrades, unlocking new rooms with different and cool features!

This game works on every device, but some features might work worse on phone/tablet/console.
